name: openclaw-runtime-externals
description: Pinned npm dependencies installed into the OpenClaw runtime artifact for undeclared upstream imports — packages that openclaw's dist/ or a bundled plugin imports at runtime but does not declare in its package.json. Keep this list minimal. Each entry should have a reason noted in the companion known-unresolved.txt or CHANGELOG. See scripts/build-openclaw-runtime.sh for how these are merged.
